note: Criteria as data, not as prompt (mirrors data/rules/species_rules.json). A document either demonstrates a criterion in extracted, span-verified text or it does not — the model never renders a pass/fail verdict on a bond; check_criteria() computes every status in code from ExtractedField values only.

criteria.label: Use of proceeds disclosed
criteria.description: The framework names the categories of projects the bond proceeds will finance.

criteria.label: Use of proceeds matches a recognised blue-economy category
criteria.description: The disclosed use-of-proceeds category matches one of the blue-economy categories corroborated in F2. This list is NOT asserted exhaustive (see blue_finance_source_register.json F2 note) — a non-match is reported as indeterminate, not a hard fail, and always says so.
criteria.pass_condition: field is supported and its normalised value is in allowed_values

criteria.label: Project evaluation and selection process disclosed
criteria.description: The framework describes how eligible projects are selected and evaluated.

criteria.label: Management of proceeds disclosed
criteria.description: The framework describes how proceeds are tracked, allocated and, if unallocated, held.

criteria.label: Impact / performance metrics disclosed
criteria.description: The framework names at least one quantifiable impact or performance metric to be reported against.

criteria.label: Reporting commitment disclosed
criteria.description: The framework commits to a reporting frequency and to disclosing use-of-proceeds / impact information to investors.

criteria.label: External review / verification commitment disclosed
criteria.description: GBP treats external review (second-party opinion, verification, certification, or rating) as a RECOMMENDED practice, not a mandatory eligibility gate. Absence is reported as unmet, but never phrased as disqualifying on its own.
